verdict.rationale: Running models larger than VRAM via CPU+GPU offload is a fair question for a local LLM runner like Jan, so the axis applies. The pack does not document any GPU-layer offload setting, partial offload, or hybrid CPU+GPU execution. The only related item notes the API server is powered by llama.cpp, which is a capability of the underlying engine, not documented Jan functionality, and so earns no credit.
